_README: Author "def": what the thing IS, in one learner-facing clause — not a list
of other translations, which the `en` gloss already gives. Match the sense
in `en`; never drift to another homograph.
"expect" is what the corpus holds now; fix-authored.ts refuses a stale row.

expect.def: sister; sister; nun; used particularly, but not only, as a title of address

rows.def: A female sibling — and the everyday German word for a nurse.

expect.def: to make, to produce, to create (an object, arrangement, situation, etc.); to make, prepare (food, drinks, etc.)

rows.def: To make or do something; German's general-purpose verb for producing or carrying out.

expect.def: to eat; to eat; to dine

rows.def: To take food into the body through the mouth.

expect.def: to buy, to purchase; to buy, to purchase for someone

rows.def: To obtain something in exchange for money.

expect.def: small, little, wee (in physical size or extent); small, little, young (not grown up)

rows.def: Little in size or extent — and, of a person, young.

expect.def: mail, post (sent and received letters etc.); mail, post, postal service (method of sending mail; organisation for it)

rows.def: The postal service, the letters it carries, and the office you hand them in at.

expect.def: to find; to discover; to think, to consider, to find

rows.def: To come across what you were looking for — and, of an opinion, to think (ich finde …).

expect.def: short, quick, brief; short

rows.def: Small in length or in duration; the opposite of lang.

expect.def: warm; mildly hot; warm; keeping the wearer warm

rows.def: Pleasantly heated — above cool and below hot.

expect.def: cold, chilly; the physical perception of something (objects, weather, body etc.) to have a low temperature; cold, frigid (especially when referring to emotions)

rows.def: Low in temperature; of a person or manner, unfeeling.

expect.def: correct, accurate, right; right, correct, good

rows.def: Free of error — and, before an adjective, thoroughly (ein richtig guter Film).

expect.def: nice; friendly; likable; nice; okay; decent; often expressing a more reluctant praise

rows.def: Pleasant and friendly in a mild, everyday way.

expect.def: black, reflecting little or no light; black, having a high amount of melanin in an organ, e.g. the skin

rows.def: The colour of coal, reflecting almost no light.

expect.def: salt, table salt, sal; salt

rows.def: Sodium chloride, used to season and preserve food.

expect.def: to fly; to travel by air; to rush; to fly; to go quickly

rows.def: To move through the air — and, of a person, to travel by plane.

expect.def: ready for use; done; fully prepared; done; finished; complete

rows.def: Finished or ready to go; colloquially also worn out.

expect.def: free; unenslaved; unimprisoned; free; unrestricted; more negative also: unrestrained; licentious

rows.def: Not restricted, and not occupied — of a seat or an appointment, available.

expect.def: sea, ocean; sea, sea condition, swell

rows.def: An inland body of standing water. (Feminine die See means the sea.)

expect.def: a star; a small luminous dot that can be seen on the night sky; a star; the actual celestial body

rows.def: A luminous point in the night sky; a celestial body like the sun.

expect.def: then, after that; then, in that case

rows.def: Next in time — and, after a condition, in that case.

expect.def: to pay; to pay, to atone

rows.def: To hand over money for something bought or owed.

expect.def: job, position, employment; job, work, profession

rows.def: Paid work, especially casual or short-term rather than a career.

expect.def: to work out, to exercise, to train; to train, to coach

rows.def: To practise a sport or skill regularly — and, of a coach, to train others.

expect.def: to press, to push (a button/key; a finger or other object against something); to push, to press, to exert pressure, to click (with a mouse)

rows.def: To apply pressure with a finger or hand: a button, a key, someone's hand.

expect.def: to tell, to narrate, to recount; to tell, to say

rows.def: To tell someone about something, recounting it in sequence.

expect.def: to drive away, to drive off; to drive away, take away with a vehicle

rows.def: To leave by vehicle — or to take something away in one.

expect.def: to stage, to perform (a dramatic work); to stage, to perpetrate (a hoax or deception)

rows.def: To put a dramatic work on stage; also to stage something for effect.

expect.def: never, never at all (referring to an indefinite period of time); never, not once (referring to a defined period of time; see usage notes below)

rows.def: At no time at all.

expect.def: practice, experience; practice, praxis (opposite of theory)

rows.def: A doctor's or lawyer's office — and practice as opposed to theory.

expect.def: program (set of structured ideas or activities; a list thereof); schedule; programming (whole of a station’s shows; their chronological order; a list thereof)

rows.def: A planned sequence of items or events; also a piece of software.

expect.def: environment; milieu; surroundings; environment; ecosystem

rows.def: The natural world around us, thought of as something to protect.

expect.def: to try, to attempt (often with an uncertain result); to try, to taste

rows.def: To make an attempt at something whose outcome is uncertain.

expect.def: to last, to continue, to persist (for a period of time); to last, to be permanent

rows.def: To go on for a stretch of time.

expect.def: decent, honorable, honest; honest, truthful, true

rows.def: Truthful, and not out to deceive.

expect.def: quarrel, dispute, fight, argument; fight, battle

rows.def: A verbal fight — a quarrel or dispute rather than a physical one.

expect.def: sharp; able to cut (of a knife, edge); sharp; tight (of a turn on a route)

rows.def: Hot to the taste; of a blade or an image, keen and well-defined.

expect.def: to work, function; to work, work out

rows.def: Of a device or an arrangement, to work as it is meant to.

expect.def: advantage, plus, benefit, perk (of a job); advantage

rows.def: Something that puts you in a better position than others.

expect.def: to gather; to assemble; to collect; to congregate; to assemble; to meet

rows.def: To bring things together in one place — objects as a hobby, or people into a group.

expect.def: witch, sorceress; witch, hag (evil and/or ugly woman)

rows.def: A woman with magic powers in folklore and fairy tales.
